authority.purpose: retrospective exploratory test of genuinely different information channels, plus a fail-closed prospective acquisition specification
pre_registration_inspection: file names, sizes, hashes, schemas, source date bounds and source fields
TDnet index URL presence and publication-time distribution
prior experiment protocols and availability conclusions
authority.note: This protocol is intentionally frozen before this lane reads oc_return_pct or label. A retrospective pass cannot promote a production model because historical source observation-time provenance and execution data are incomplete.

jpx_daily_ohlc.availability_limit: No volume, turnover, VWAP, trading unit, bid, ask or market-cap field.

monthly_jpx_pdfs.fields: AM/PM OHLC only; no usable volume, turnover, lot, order book, futures or PTS fields

point_in_time_policy.feature_availability: published_at and local source_received_at and parse_completed_at must all be at or before the decision cutoff
point_in_time_policy.historical_limitation: The HTML caches have publication timestamps but no immutable local receipt sidecars. They are historical-only provenance and therefore exploratory.
point_in_time_policy.source_completeness: Require every calendar-date index page from the prior panel session through the target session. Missing source means excluded, never no-event.
point_in_time_policy.document_completeness: Numeric/body hypotheses require a byte-identical document object plus receipt timestamp and parser version. URL-only records fail closed.
point_in_time_policy.outcome_separation: Feature artifacts must be frozen before open/close labels are joined. Actual open, close, volume and execution records live in a separate label ledger.

registered_data_generation_hypotheses.fixed_features: signed percent change and absolute delta for each same-period/same-scope metric; denominator-zero gets an explicit flag and no invented percentage
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.test_policy: rank event stocks by a regularized model on the frozen numeric vector; no title text

registered_data_generation_hypotheses.information_channel: TDnet numeric table plus PIT shares and D-1 close
raw_fields: shares outstanding excluding treasury at D-1
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.fixed_features: profit delta divided by D-1 market capitalization, with currency/unit validation
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.test_policy: event-only ranking; fail closed on stale shares, mixed currency, period mismatch or missing units

registered_data_generation_hypotheses.information_channel: TDnet buyback decision table plus PIT capital structure
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.test_policy: event-only ranking; initial decisions only, never status reports

registered_data_generation_hypotheses.information_channel: all cached disclosures for the same code and target session
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.test_policy: monthly walk-forward Ridge on structured flags only; no character or word title vectorizer

registered_data_generation_hypotheses.information_channel: TDnet publication clock and deterministic fiscal-period tokens
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.test_policy: monthly walk-forward Ridge on clock/period metadata only; no title TF-IDF

registered_data_generation_hypotheses.information_channel: TDnet PDF bytes or official structured payload
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.fixed_features: table density, number of revised metrics and cross-table agreement; never OCR-derived signs without confidence threshold
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.test_policy: abstain when PDF bytes, receipt timestamp or parser confidence is absent
body rules override supportive title flags; URL or title alone cannot assert absence of negation
exact snapshots at or before 08:58:59; daily futures OHLC and CFDs are forbidden proxies
freeze four times 08:57:00/08:58:00/08:58:30/08:58:55; never substitute the actual open
night and partial day sessions stay separate; no-activity, unavailable and unsupported are distinct

registered_data_generation_hypotheses.information_channel: D-1 daily volume/turnover plus effective-dated security master
registered_data_generation_hypotheses.test_policy: D-1 or earlier only; missing files are not zero volume; proxies never share names with observed spread or slippage

estimator.target: within-session percentile of observed open-to-close return transformed to [-1,1]

retrospective_implementation.walk_forward: Refit at each score month using only earlier strict-source-complete sessions; require at least 20 prior complete sessions and 100 training event bundles.
retrospective_implementation.missing_gap: Sessions without a strict-complete TDnet index bundle are excluded. The 2024-08 through 2025-03 cache gap is not imputed.

evaluation.slot_weighting: equal; unfilled event-only slots are cash
evaluation.primary_metric: mean daily net return at 40 bps
secondary_metrics: top-10 profit-contributing codes replaced by cash

familywise.family: three implementable candidate policies times top1/top2
familywise.method: Holm correction over two-sided daily paired tests versus L4 on intersecting scored sessions
familywise.interpretation: informational only; dependence and retrospective provenance prevent a production claim

evaluation.independent_pnl_audit: A separate audit program must recompute gross/net P&L directly from saved picks, verify equal slot weights and costs, and compare every serialized metric within 1e-12.

promotion_gate.reason: Historical receipt-time provenance, actual execution/slippage, auction, futures, PTS and PIT liquidity are absent.
minimum_future_evidence: append-only prospective feature ledger with at least 98% cutoff-valid coverage
sequestered forward labels and independent P&L audit
positive mean at 40 bps for top1 and top2 over a predeclared forward horizon
positive result after top-day and top-code removal
familywise-adjusted evidence and no material tail deterioration
observed spread/slippage, lot-size and capacity checks
operational replay with zero post-cutoff feature violations
